author: JDVance
text:
My friend @RogerMarshallMD is a good Christian man, a loyal servant to the state of Kansas, and a great doctor who has devoted his life to helping moms and babies. 

Left wing lunatics will never stop slandering the names of good people who love this country, but Kansas voters will make their voices heard in November when they send the crazy people packing.
